IMPORTANT VOCABULARY
G1 Phase - The first stage of interphase where the cell grows and produces necessary proteins for DNA replication.
S Phase - The phase where DNA replication occurs, ensuring each daughter cell receives an identical copy of genetic material.
G2 Phase - The final stage of interphase where the cell continues to grow and prepares for mitosis by checking for DNA replication errors.
Mitosis (M Phase) - The process where the nucleus divides into two identical nuclei, ensuring genetic material is evenly distributed.
